tables.title: Application for Patent in Fee - Question and Answer Record (Form 5-105)

rows.Question Text: Age?
Degree of blood?
Married or single?
Did you attend school? If so, where and how long?
rows.Answer: Since I was 8 years of age I have attended school continuously

rows.Question Text: Do you use intoxicants?
Are you in good physical condition?
What is the value of the land covered by your application?
Does your application cover your own allotment or inherited land?
Does your application cover all or a part of your land?
Do you cultivate your land?
Have you any other occupation?
Are you self-supporting? If so, how is your self-support obtained?
Have you accumulated any property? If so, what?
Are you in debt? If so, whom do you owe, how much, and for what, and have you given security for the debts?
Have you been given a patent in fee for a part of your land? If so, did you sell it, and what use did you make of the proceeds of the sale?
Have you any inherited land? If so, what is your interest in the estate and what is the value of the allotment?
Have you sold any inherited land? If so, what use was made of the proceeds?
Have you any individual Indian money to your credit with the superintendent? If so, how much?
rows.Answer: no money I chose cattle instead

rows.Question Text: Have you been given the privilege of leasing your own land?
Is your land leased? If so, what rent do you receive?
Have you made a contract to sell your land? If so, to whom, and at what price?
Has anyone asked you to procure a patent in fee for the purpose of disposing of your land?
Have other members of your family allotments of their own? If so, give names, sex, ages, relationship, and number of acres, and approximate value of each allotment.
rows.Answer: all of my brothers and sisters have allotments and parents too

rows.Question Text: What members of your family, if any, have no allotment? Designate those dependent on you for support, and give reasons, stating ages and sex.
What practical business experience have you had?
Have you other lands that would continue to be held in trust after the lands described in this application are released? If so, give acreage, value, and character of improvements thereon.
rows.Answer: I have none but want to sell this to buy cheaper land for range for our stock
